# Quarterly operations report — May–July 2026

## Summary

The quarter was profitable, generating €1,233,225 in revenue and €765,585 in net income at a 62.1% margin. Revenue grew in June before falling in July, while the customer base increased by 153 and support maintained a 95.5% ticket close rate.

## Key figures

| Figure | Value |
|---|---:|
| Quarterly revenue | €1,233,225 |
| Quarterly costs | €467,640 |
| Net | €765,585 |
| Margin | 62.1% |
| Net customer adds | 153 |
| Ticket close rate | 95.5% |
| June revenue growth | 4.6% |
| July revenue growth | -9.6% |

## Notes

July revenue fell 9.6% month over month after June's 4.6% growth. Customer churn rose each month, from 17 in May to 31 in July, and net customer adds slowed accordingly. Cloud and office and travel costs also increased across the quarter, while support closed nearly all tickets opened.
